top_signals.title: Obscure UAE Firms Hold Key to Radiant’s $1 Billion in Assets
top_signals.summary: As creditors, counterparties and lawyers pore over the business of embattled commodity trader Radiant World, a low-rise office building in the emirate of Ajman, just north of Dubai, may contain one key piece of the puzzle.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
